name: token-zombie

plugins.name: token-zombie
plugins.description: Local-first token saver for Claude Code: guard hooks, supervisor, handoffs, optimizer, skill audit.

plugins.name: studio-tasks
plugins.description: TZ Studio: /studio-tasks pane showing each Studio project's tasks and their status; reads files only when drawn.

plugins.name: tz-assumption-check
plugins.description: /assumptions asks Claude to list its guesses; /assumptions wrong 2 4 sends the wrong ones back. Only costs tokens when used.

plugins.name: tz-auto-prompter
plugins.description: /queue add <prompt>: prompts sent one by one after each turn finishes. Idle until used.

plugins.name: tz-blast-radius
plugins.description: Warns before destructive Bash commands

plugins.name: tz-browser-saver
plugins.description: Warns after repeated screenshots

plugins.name: tz-cache-clock
plugins.description: Warns when the prompt cache has gone cold

plugins.name: tz-chat-thermometer
plugins.description: Status line showing chat size (cool/warm/hot at the owner's 100k rule) from turn usage. No model call.

plugins.name: tz-design-picker
plugins.description: /design-picker writes a visual page of design styles to open and choose from. Static, no model call.

plugins.name: tz-effort-optimizer
plugins.description: Suggests an effort level from the task wording

plugins.name: tz-fake-data-mode
plugins.description: /fake on|off: opt-in rule to use obvious placeholder data, never real personal data.

plugins.name: tz-folder-tracker
plugins.description: /here lists the other sessions in this same folder and their status so they do not undo each other. Local files only.

plugins.name: tz-handoff
plugins.description: Writes the daily handoff note

plugins.name: tz-idea-shelf
plugins.description: Token Zombie: park ideas per project with /idea instead of derailing the chat; zero cost until used.

plugins.name: tz-image-viewer
plugins.description: Opens an image file in the system viewer

plugins.name: tz-input-router
plugins.description: Suggests model, effort and skill pack for a task

plugins.name: tz-jargon-buster
plugins.description: /jargon <term or text>: one Haiku call explains it in plain words.

plugins.name: tz-load
plugins.description: /load <pack>|off <pack>|list: turn Token Zombie skill packs on or off through ~/.claude/skillpack.

plugins.name: tz-next-steps
plugins.description: Suggests three next actions on request

plugins.name: tz-plain-english
plugins.description: /plain on|off: opt-in plain-English reply rules (short words, summary last, next steps). Off by default so it adds no tokens.

plugins.name: tz-plan-progress
plugins.description: Shows the work as a checklist on request

plugins.name: tz-prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: Opt-in /enhance: one cheap Haiku call turns a rough prompt into a structured one (skills to load, questions first, done criteria). No cost until used.

plugins.name: tz-rule-enforcer
plugins.description: /rule add <regex>: refuse Bash commands matching stored rules. Local, no model call.

plugins.name: tz-session-monitor
plugins.description: /sessions lists running Claude Code sessions: working, waiting or idle. Reads local files only.

plugins.name: tz-subagent-model
plugins.description: Runs search-type subagents on Haiku

plugins.name: tz-theme-switcher
plugins.description: /skin paper|midnight|forest: switch the app look (desktop/mobile only; terminal draws none).

description: TOKEN ZOMBIE: local-first token saver plugin for Claude Code.
